_comment: Scores REAL, literature-backed ligands (recovered from the raw pesticide reference CSVs) against dta_davis, as a baseline to compare against top_candidates.csv's GA-generated candidates for the same 53 acaricide targets.
_targets_comment: No 'targets' list given, so all 53 target_chembl_id values from targets_csv are used -- same universe as top_candidates.csv, for direct comparison.
